about_the_game:
🔸 About This DLC

This DLC provides a curated collection of high-quality textures and visual materials, designed specifically for mature-themed content within the game. Each texture is delivered in optimized 1024×1024 PNG format (averaging ~1.2MB per asset), ensuring a balance between performance and visual richness.

Crafted through AI-assisted workflows and artistic refinement, this asset pack includes character overlays, mood-driven decals, environmental detail maps, and symbolically charged props. Whether you're expanding story-driven cutscenes or deepening the emotional tone of interactive scenes, these assets are designed to support narrative immersion with a mature edge.

🧩 Design Features:

  • 49 Images

  • Resolution: 1024×1024 PNG, optimized for in-game performance

  • Includes: Character overlays, erotic decals, dark symbolic props, and atmospheric textures

  • Seamless integration into material and shader systems

  • Intended for use in mature-rated content, visual storytelling, or custom DLC development

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 or SteamOS 3.0 (or equivalent)
  • Processor: Any 64-bit processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.0 compatible GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Contains only static PNG files. No executable or runtime required.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11 or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated or discrete GPU
  • Storage: 100 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Static image files only. Compatible with all standard archive viewers.
